data.short_meaning: The two just ones (dual of ʿādil); also used for a just ruler
data.long_meaning: Aadilaan (عادلان) is a dual/plural form of ʿādil, 'just', meaning 'the two just ones'. It also appears as an honorific-type name meaning 'just one'. The form is uncommon and is graded at medium confidence.

faq.q: What does the name Aadilaan mean?
faq.a: Aadilaan means The two just ones (dual of ʿādil); also used for a just ruler.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aadilaan?
What language does the name Aadilaan come from?
faq.a: Aadilaan is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aadilaan a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadilaan is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aadilaan written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aadilaan is written عادلان in Arabic and عادلان in Urdu, and आदिलान in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aadilaan?
faq.a: The root of Aadilaan is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aadilaan?
Does Aadilaan appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic name; formed from the Arabic root ʿ-d-l.
It is a dual/plural form of ʿādil, 'just', meaning 'the two just ones'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aadilaan?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadilaan total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aadilaan?
faq.a: Aadilaan appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Adilan, Aadilan.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aadilaan?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aadilaan include Aadil, Aadila.
Yes. Both come from the root ʿ-d-l; Aadil is ʿādil and Aadilaan is its dual/plural form.

faq.q: Where is the name Aadilaan used today?
faq.a: Aadilaan is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
